text:
Most people have at least one money leak they don't know about.

A subscription they forgot. A medical bill nobody checked. A refund they never asked for.

I made a free 60 second check: 7 questions, then your top 2 leaks and the step by step fix for each.

No sign up: https://autopilotoi.app/quiz/

Reply with what it found. I'm curious which one is most common.

Quick question for you.

Which of these have you NOT done in the last 12 months?

1. Checked your credit report
2. Looked for subscriptions you don't use
3. Asked for a raise
4. Checked a medical bill line by line

If it's 2 or more, this free 60 second check shows where to start: https://autopilotoi.app/quiz/
